positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leading projects and develop e-commerce related Ad Platforms and Audience Platforms.

- Developed centralized Audience Data Platform to ingest and process high-volume e-commerce event streams, creating a unified "single source of truth" for user behavior.
- Developed applications that leveraged audience telemetry to drive precision ad targeting, real-time
ranking, and personalized user experiences and recommendations.
- Developed a real-time bidding (RTB) engine for search and display advertising, leveraging Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize bid strategies in dynamic market environments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led projects and develop end-to-end CTV and Video advertising platforms for high scale Supply Side
Platform (SSP) and Demand Side Platform (DSP) integrating Auction Theory, Game Theory, Simulation
based Optimization, and Machine Learning (Reinforcement Learning).

- Bidding Engine with Reinforcement Learning
- Auction Engine with multi attribute winner selection mechanism
- Header Bidding 
- Optimal Floor Price Recommendation System
- Yield Optimization System
- Bidding and Pacing Optimization
- Auction Simulator to verify auction strategy, bidding optimization and etc.
- Traffic Simulator (Ad request traffic and Bid request traffic) for n-to-n test of SSP (Supply Side Platform) and DSP (Demand Side Platform).
- Whitebox Test Framework for testing Bidding Engine, Pacing Engine and etc.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Develop location based services for mobile devices (including mobile phones and tablets).

positions.title: Senior Researcher
positions.description:
- Research and development innovative mobile solutions, services and applications for social network and applications, mobile collaboration, unified communications, location based services, mobile entertainment, mobile sensing and crowdsourcing, mobile commerce and ecosystem  using platform independent mobile web technologies and various mobile platforms.

- Creating project idea, developing robust mobile system, conducting pilot, field test and user study, creating intellectual property, publishing research results in major conferences and journals and technology transfer to business unit.

projects.title: 0. Bidding Engine & Ad Pacing Engine for DSP (Demand Side Platform)
projects.description:
- Engineered an algorithmic bidding engine for programmatic Real Time Bidding (RTB) to compute optimal bid prices, utilizing multi-objective linear programming (MOLP) and Reinforcement Learning-based adaptive bidding mechanisms.
- Developed a dynamic budget pacing system based on real-time supply estimation and inventory valuation to maximize delivery efficiency across diverse inventory.

projects.title: 1. Auction Engine & Yield Optimization for SSP (Supply Side Platform)
projects.description:
- Architected and developed a programmatic Auction Engine supporting Open/Private auctions and First/Second price models to maximize publisher yield.
-  Developed a Multi-attribute Winner Selection Algorithm with dynamic configuration capabilities based on real-time revenue metrics.
- Engineered an asynchronous processing pipeline handling multi-million bid requests per second, ensuring sub-millisecond latency.
- Engineered a two-tier Yield Optimization System featuring optimal winner selection algorithms, dynamic floor pricing, and unified auction frameworks with second-price mechanisms (e.g, VCG auction, Generalized Second Price Auction and etc.)
